title: Signal: SQL built by concatenation (apex) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on concatenated SQL in apex code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any concatenated query matches, including trusted assembly. Input trust needs human review.

examples.line: Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = ' + name)

fpNotes: Assembling fixed column lists or trusted fragments is the common false positive.
